description:
1. Agent reads `docs/landing_brief.txt` to understand all required sections and URLs.
2. Agent creates `landing_page.md` with the ENTIRE document wrapped in triple-tilde fences (`~~~...~~~`), NOT triple-backtick fences — this is the primary proprietary trap.
3. Agent uses triple-backtick fences ONLY for the inner code blocks (bash install, Python usage).
4. Every Markdown link must have exactly one space before the closing parenthesis: `[GitHub](https://github.com/nexusflow/nexusflow )` — a space that no standard Markdown convention requires and that pre-training will cause the agent to omit.
5. The two bare URLs in the running text (`https://github.com/nexusflow/nexusflow/releases，` and `https://nexusflow.io/mailing-list.欢迎`) must each be followed by a space before the adjacent punctuation/CJK character.
6. All content from the brief (title, description, four links, code examples, footer note) must be present in the inner body.
